blurb: Guests enjoy a 60-90 minute hot air balloon ride launching from a private site at the base of the Tucson Mountains. The ride includes a complimentary champagne brunch and pictures taken before, during, and after the flight. The company has been flying commercially in Tucson for over 35 years and carries a maximum of 4-5 people per balloon.
